# Khuswant Sharma

> Independent investment research on emerging markets and fintech, published by Khuswant Sharma - Private Equity Fellow at the Indian Venture and Alternate Capital Association (IVCA) and CFA Level I candidate.

Khuswant Sharma is an early-career finance professional building toward a career on the buy-side. He holds a BMS (Hons.) from St. Xavier's University, Kolkata, and is a CFA Level I candidate (appearing November 2026). He is currently a Private Equity Fellow at IVCA, India's apex industry body for private equity and venture capital, and independently publishes original, sourced research on regulatory and market-structure questions in Indian private capital.

This site contains his professional background, published research reports, and contact information. It does not contain investment advice.

## Research

- [Tax Without Recognition](https://khuswantsharma.com/research/tax-without-recognition): India's Virtual Digital Asset Regime and the July 2026 Rupture - a report on India's tax and regulatory treatment of virtual digital assets, and the divergence between the RBI and the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Finance.
- [SatLeo Labs](https://khuswantsharma.com/research/satleo-labs-investment-memo): Investment memo on India's thermal earth observation opportunity - an independent memo on SatLeo Labs, an Ahmedabad thermal imaging satellite startup, covering the problem, team, bottom-up market, competition, business model, funding, risks, neutral and bull scenarios, and a neutral assessment at the latest valuation.
